name: Cloudflare One
summary: Cloudflare One is a zero trust platform whose device client encrypts traffic and connects people to private networks. Dedicated egress IPs, which no other customer shares, are an add-on only for Zero Trust Enterprise plans. Cloudflare lists no prices on its plans page and sells Cloudflare One packaging through sales.

facts.text: The Cloudflare One Client encrypts and routes a device's internet and private network traffic through Cloudflare, using WireGuard or MASQUE.
Dedicated egress IPs are static addresses assigned exclusively to one account and are only available as an add-on to Zero Trust Enterprise plans.
User management in Zero Trust covers seat management, SCIM provisioning, a viewer for SCIM users and groups, user logs and risk score.
Cloudflare's plans page lists no prices for its SASE offering and says Cloudflare One packaging is handled through sales.

plans.name: Cloudflare One
plans.notes: No prices are published on the plans page. Dedicated egress IPs need a Zero Trust Enterprise plan.
